tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: List tasks in your workspace. Filter by status, priority, project, assignee, due date, or search by title. Returns up to 50 tasks ordered by most recent.

project_id.description: Filter tasks belonging to a specific project (project ID).

assigned_to.description: Filter tasks assigned to a specific user. Accepts user ID or partial name/email. Admin only for filtering by others.

due_date.description: Filter tasks due on this date (Y-m-d format).

success.description: True when the operation succeeded, false on error.

data.description: The records returned by the query.

error.description: Error message; present only when success is false.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get Task
tools.description: Get full details of a single task by ID, title, or heading. Returns subtasks, comments, files, and assigned user.

id.description: The numeric ID of the task.

heading.description: The task heading/title (partial match), used when the id is unknown. If more than one task matches, the tool returns an error listing them and does nothing — use id to target exactly one.

success.description: True when the operation succeeded, false on error.

error.description: Error message; present only when success is false.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Create a new task. Requires a heading/title. Optionally assign to a user by name or ID, link to a project, set priority and due date.

project_id.description: ID of the project to link this task to.

assigned_to.description: User to assign the task to. Accepts user ID or partial name/email. Defaults to the requesting user.

due_date.description: Due date in Y-m-d format. Defaults to 7 days from today.

start_date.description: Start date in Y-m-d format. Defaults to today.

success.description: True when the operation succeeded, false on error.

error.description: Error message; present only when success is false.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update Task
tools.description: Update an existing task. Look up by ID or heading/title. Updatable fields: heading, description, status, priority, due_date, start_date, project_id, task_category_id, assigned_to.

id.description: Task ID to look up and update.

heading.description: Current task heading used to locate the task by name (partial match). If more than one task matches, the tool returns an error listing them and does nothing — use id to target exactly one.

title.description: Alias for heading (used to locate the task).

new_heading.description: New title to replace the existing task heading.

description.description: New task description. Pass null to clear.

due_date.description: New due date (Y-m-d). Pass null to clear.

start_date.description: New start date (Y-m-d). Pass null to clear.

project_id.description: Link or re-link the task to a project by ID. Pass null to unlink.

task_category_id.description: Task category ID. Pass null to clear.

assigned_to.description: Re-assign the task to a user (ID or name/email). Admin or users with add_tasks permission only.

success.description: True when the operation succeeded, false on error.

error.description: Error message; present only when success is false.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.title: Delete Task

id.description: The numeric ID of the task to delete.

success.description: True when the operation succeeded, false on error.

error.description: Error message; present only when success is false.
